description: This is a spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

use_action.done_message: You set the beartrap.

description: This is a machete attached laterally to a motor, with a tripwire controlling its throttle.  When the tripwire is pulled, the blade is swung around with great force.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect.

use_action.done_message: You set the blade trap %d squares away.

description: These are several pieces of wood nailed together, with some nails sticking straight up.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on it, they'll get nails through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You set the board trap on the %s, nails facing up.

description: This is a crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to set up and watch some poor bastard trigger it.

use_action.done_message: You set the booby trap up and activate the grenade.

description: This is a sheet of plastic covered with air-filled bubbles.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will warn you with noise when something steps on it.

use_action.done_message: You set the bubble wrap on the ground, ready to be popped.

description: These are small metal objects covered with many sharp points.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a spine through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the caltrops on the %s.

description: These are glass shards glued together to expose their sharp edges.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get cut.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the glass caltrops on the %s.

description: This is a simple tripwire, which is attached to the trigger of a loaded crossbow.  When pulled, the crossbow fires.  Only a single round can be used, after which the trap is disabled.

use_action.done_message: You set the crossbow trap.

description: This is a military anti-personnel mine that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You set the land mine.

description: This is a simple tripwire attached to the trigger of a loaded double-barreled shotgun.  When pulled, the shotgun fires, discharging both barrels into the target.

use_action.done_message: You set the shotgun trap.

description: This is a simple tripwire attached to the trigger of a loaded single-barreled shotgun.  When pulled, the shotgun fires.

use_action.done_message: You set the shotgun trap.

description: This is some thin strong cable with some affixing tools on either end.  A tripwire trap must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  Its purpose is to trip up bypassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.

use_action.done_message: You string up the tripwire.

description: This is a set of empty cans used as makeshift noisemakers, strung up across a doorway or other thin passage.  It will make noise when activated to alert you of intruders, but is otherwise harmless.

use_action.done_message: You string up some cans on a tripwire.

description: Same glass shard as before but you can activate it to place it on the ground, it will make noise when stepped on.

use_action.done_message: You carefully place the shards on the ground, ready to be cracked by something passing by.

description: A tripwire rigged to a small incendiary charge.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  When triggered, it bursts into flame, burning whatever crosses it.

use_action.done_message: You string up the incendiary tripwire.

description: A tripwire rigged to a pressurized vial of acid.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  When triggered, it sprays acid on whatever crosses it.

use_action.done_message: You string up the acid tripwire.

description: A tripwire rigged to a capacitor and cable spool.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  When triggered, it discharges electricity into whatever crosses it.

use_action.done_message: You string up the electric tripwire.

description: A net on a spring-loaded frame, staked to the ground.  When something steps on it, the net snaps shut around its leg, holding it in place until it breaks free.

use_action.done_message: You set the net snare.

description: Spring-loaded spears hidden in a floor compartment, triggered by a pressure plate.  When something steps on it, the spears stab upward into its leg with considerable force.

use_action.done_message: You set the spear snare.

description: A homemade anti-personnel mine packed with extra shrapnel instead of raw explosive.  It is triggered when stepped upon.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

bury.done_message: You bury the shrapnel land mine.

use_action.done_message: You set the shrapnel land mine.

description: A homemade incendiary mine that bursts into flame and blast when stepped upon.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

use_action.done_message: You set the incendiary mine.

description: Several machetes mounted radially on a motor, with a pressure plate controlling its throttle.  When triggered, the blades spin wildly, hitting anything on or next to the device.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect.

use_action.done_message: You set the thresher %d squares away.

description: A tripwire rigged to an electromagnetic pulse generator.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage.  When triggered, it emits a pulse that disrupts electronics and briefly stuns whatever crosses it.

use_action.done_message: You string up the EMP trap.

description: A sprinkler head jury-rigged to the plumbing system.  When something steps on it, it sprays the liquid currently held by the connected fluid grid over the surrounding area.  It keeps spraying until the plumbing runs dry.  Fill the tank with the liquid of your choice before placing it.

use_action.done_message: You install the sprinkler trap.

description: A small floor compartment holding an inactive bot.  When an enemy steps on it or next to it, the compartment opens and releases the bot.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect and is used up once triggered.

use_action.done_message: You install the bot hatch %d squares away.

description: A wire rigged to discharge the base's electrical grid.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage on a tile connected to a powered distribution grid.  When triggered, it drains grid power and shocks whatever crosses it.  It keeps firing as long as the grid has charge.

use_action.done_message: You string up the tesla wire.
